title: customer-success
text:
customer-success

Tom (Support): FYI NexusPay trial hitting onboarding failures — embed ingestion 502 + SSO token hangs. Customer reported drop in conversion. Escalating to CS for priority handoff. Logs: 502 from /api/ingest at 2026-03-23T14:02Z. @Aisha can you pick up? :rotating_light:
Aisha (CS Manager): On it. Any repro steps or temporary workaround from support? What's the renewal horizon?
Tom (Support): Repro steps: POST payload to /v1/ingest with user_id header => 502 intermittently. Short-term workaround: retry x3 with 2s backoff stabilizes. Renewal in ~6 weeks, pilot tier, risk flagged by sales.
Diego (Solutions Eng): I can join a debug call — suspect batching/KV cache edge-case. Seen similar when batch_size default is high. Can we get a request_id to trace?
Tom (Support): request_id=rp_7f3c. Also saw a provisioning 403 for one tenant early 3/22 — might be related to token rotation timing.
Marin (Enablement): Recommend a quick enablement + runbook session today. Proposed comms plan: 1) Acknowledge within 1h, 2) Share remediation steps + ETA, 3) Invite to shared debug session with SEs, 4) Provide follow-up cadence (daily until stable). I can draft the message.
Aisha (CS Manager): Agreed — priority P1 for CS. I'll lead comms and book a 30m sync with NexusPay for 16:00 PT today. Diego, can you join and bring traces?
Diego (Solutions Eng): Yep — I'll bring request traces, kernel/runtime sampling, and a short checklist of config tweaks to try. Also recommend we capture a tiny eval prompt set post-fix to monitor quality/regressions.
Tom (Support): Posted a filtered log view: https://logs.redwood.io/search?query=rp_7f3c — set incident tag #nexuspay-onboard. Also collected last 10 failed request_ids in a gist for SEs.
deploy-bot: incident nexuspay-6901234567 created, severity: P1, assignees: Tom, Aisha, Diego.
Aisha (CS Manager): Thanks. Action items: Marin — send calendar invite + draft comms by 15:00 PT; Tom — add last 10 failed request_ids to thread; Diego — collect traces + quick repro script; I'll prepare a one-paragraph renewal-risk note for RevOps. Will follow up here with the comms copy. :thumbsup:
